gloss: to see and hear; to experience firsthand; to learn through observation

definitions.gloss: to see and hear; to experience firsthand; to learn through observation
definitions.explanation: To gain knowledge or information by directly seeing and hearing things. Implies personal, firsthand experience rather than learning from books or hearsay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧で{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見聞|みき}きした。
examples.english: I saw and learned many things during the trip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{見聞|みき}きしたこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧。
examples.english: To report on what I saw and heard on-site.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}いうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見聞|みき}き→見聞き：21483_mikiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{糧|かて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Broadening one's horizons overseas while young will be an asset for the future.

notes:
Combines ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see) and ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear) into a compound verb meaning to experience through one's own senses. The noun form ⟦{見聞|けんぶん}→見聞：20127_kenbun⟧ (also read みきき) means 'knowledge gained through experience.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{見聞|みき}き→見聞き：21483_mikiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to broaden one's horizons/experience
- {見聞|みき}きしたこと: things one has seen and heard
- {見聞|みき}きした⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: stories from firsthand experience

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{見聞|けんぶん}→見聞：20127_kenbun⟧: knowledge; experience (noun, on'yomi reading)
- {見聞録|けんぶんろく}: travel account; observations record
- ⟦{体験|たいけん}する→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧: to experience — broader, includes any personal experience
